phase_0_analysis.detail: Analyzed old tools/ (17 files) + OpenCode Function system. Old pattern: BaseTool with raw JSON schema dicts, ToolResult(data: str). New pattern: Generic Tool[I,O] with Pydantic input/output models, typed ToolResult[O].

phase_2_plan.detail: 14 tools decomposed into TDD batches. Each tool needs: Pydantic input/output model + Tool subclass + execute() logic port + tests.

files_created: src/cscode/tools2/read.py — ReadTool: ReadInput(path) → ReadOutput(content, size, path)
src/cscode/tools2/write.py — WriteTool: WriteInput(path, content) → WriteOutput(path, size, message)
src/cscode/tools2/edit.py — EditTool: EditInput(path, old_string, new_string) → EditOutput(path, replacement_count, message)
src/cscode/tools2/bash.py — BashTool: BashInput(command, timeout) → BashOutput(output, exit_code)
src/cscode/tools2/grep.py — GrepTool: GrepInput(pattern, path, include) → GrepOutput(matches, files_scanned, output)
src/cscode/tools2/glob.py — GlobTool: GlobInput(pattern, path) → GlobOutput(matches[], count)
src/cscode/tools2/webfetch.py — WebFetchTool: WebFetchInput(url, format, timeout) → WebFetchOutput(content, url, format, size)
src/cscode/tools2/apply_patch.py — ApplyPatchTool: ApplyPatchInput(path, patch_content, strip) → ApplyPatchOutput(stdout)
src/cscode/tools2/browser.py — BrowserTool: BrowserInput(action, url, selector, text, key, seconds) → BrowserOutput(result)
tests_created: tests/test_tools2_impl.py — 13 tests for Read/Write/Edit + Registry integration
tests/test_tools2_all.py — 24 tests for remaining 11 tools + full registry

phase_4_verify.mypy: Success: no issues found in 17 source files
fixes_applied: conftest.py merged: tools2 contract fixtures into main conftest.py
base.py: input_schema/output_schema changed from @property to class attributes
base.py: I/O TypeVars renamed to InputT/OutputT (ruff E741)
todowrite.py: removed unused `typing.Any` import, fixed __init__ type annotation
test_tools2_contract.py: _safe_execute uses asyncio.run() instead of deprecated get_event_loop()
test_tools2_contract.py: _DupTool uses class attributes for input_schema/output_schema

phase_5_review.note: No new ratchet rules needed. All issues were within the new tools2/ code and existing patterns were followed.
